section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a psychometric validation study of the Romanian translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) conducted with Romanian university students. Study 1 involved 453 university students who completed the BAS-2 along with measures of disordered eating, self-esteem, life satisfaction, and happiness. Study 2 involved a separate sample of 109 university students who completed only the BAS-2 at two time-points three weeks apart to assess test-retest reliability. The analyses revealed a one-dimensional factor structure for BAS-2 in both women and men, with adequate fit but lack of sex invariance, and demonstrated internal consistency, convergent validity, and test-retest reliability.
